leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Initialize reactive state to track a numeric counter value
Implement event handlers to increment and decrement the counter
Bind the counter value to display it dynamically in the template
Configure a reset function to restore the counter to its initial state
Construct a Vue component with proper structure and lifecycle hooks
Apply conditional rendering to display messages based on counter thresholds
Integrate button controls with corresponding event listeners
